reponse: The contract sets the Go-Live Date as December 7, 2026, conditional on the customer completing onboarding five business days before [1]. If Quillon causes delay, the customer gets a credit of 5% of monthly Platform Fees per full week, capped at 25%, as its sole remedy [1]. Tomer Golan owns the Tradewell cutover end to end, while Ellen is the owner on the customer side [2]. On the kickoff call Martin said they'd rather wait until February than go live mid-January, though Rachel confirmed December 7 is what's planned [4].
